name: System Resource & NUMA Configuration
description: Inventory and monitor host/instance compute topology: NUMA nodes, CPU counts, sockets, memory sizing and affinity. Baseline for capacity and misconfiguration health checks.

name: Active Sessions & Wait Health
description: Monitor the live request workload: which sessions are running, what they wait on, who blocks whom, isolation levels and per-request resource consumption.

name: Active Transaction Health
description: Monitor open transactions: duration, idle sessions holding transactions, transaction log consumption, blocking and the statements involved.

name: Recent Connection Activity
description: Monitor sessions that connected in the last two minutes: who, from where, how authenticated, what they run and whether they already hold locks. Surfaces connection churn, login storms and immediately-locking newcomers.

name: Top Resource-Consuming Queries
description: Track the cached statements consuming the most CPU (and their IO profile) so regressions and runaway ad-hoc workloads surface early.

name: Agent Job Failures
description: Detect SQL Agent jobs that failed or were canceled in the last 24 hours, at step and job-outcome level, with recovery status. Complements the HLTH-SQL-SJ issue family.

name: Buffer Pool Distribution
description: Track which databases occupy the buffer pool (data cache), including dirty-page volume, to spot cache-hog databases, sudden working-set shifts and checkpoint pressure.

name: I/O Distribution & Latency
description: Track which databases drive the I/O load and what latency they experience, split by data and log files, to spot I/O hogs and storage bottlenecks.

name: Agent Alert Configuration
description: Inventory SQL Agent alerts: what fires, on what condition, who gets notified and when each alert last fired. Surfaces disabled alerts, alerts notifying nobody, and instances with no alert coverage at all.

name: Procedure Performance Profile
description: Track average duration, CPU and IO per cached stored procedure to catch procedure-level regressions.

name: File-Level I/O Stalls
description: Per-file average I/O stall latency -- the drill-down under the per-database view: which specific data or log file sits on slow storage.

name: Lock Contention Hotspots
description: Identify the exact tables/indexes where sessions wait on row and page locks, with cumulative and average block-wait times.

name: Active Blocking Chains
description: Live blocked-session snapshot with full blocker identity: who is blocked, by whom, on what resource, and what both sides are running.

name: Buffer Manager Health
description: Buffer Manager performance counters: cache hit ratio computed correctly against its base counter, page life expectancy and memory-pressure indicators.

name: Instance Configuration Baseline
description: Full sys.configurations inventory each collection cycle: the baseline for configuration-drift detection and pending-change alerts.

name: Connection & Network I/O Profile
description: Inventory of live connections with their network transport, encryption, auth scheme and packet I/O counters: who is connected, over what, and how chatty.

name: CPU Utilization History
description: Minute-by-minute CPU utilization history from the scheduler-monitor ring buffer: SQL process vs other processes vs idle, up to ~4 hours back.

name: CPU Distribution by Database
description: Which databases consume the CPU, derived from cached-plan statistics: rank, share and execution volume per database.

name: Database Growth Trend
description: Database growth measured from full-backup sizes over the last 90 days: per-backup deltas, growth rate per day and backup recency.

name: Dynamic Data Masking Inventory
description: Inventory of every column protected by Dynamic Data Masking across all user databases: where masking is applied and with which function.

name: Storage Capacity Forecast
description: Per file: size, autogrowth setting, hosting volume free space, backup-derived growth rate and projected days until the volume fills.

name: Data File Space Usage
description: Allocated vs unallocated space inside the data files of every database, including the tempdb version-store and object breakdown.

name: Deadlock Detection
description: Actual deadlock events from the system_health Extended Events session, with the victim identity and the full deadlock graph.

name: Volume Free Space
description: One row per volume hosting database files: capacity, free space and percent free, with the count and size of database files it hosts.

name: Volume I/O Latency
description: Average I/O latency and transfer size aggregated per volume/drive - the storage-tier health rollup.

name: Errorlog Error Scan
description: Error and severity lines from the SQL Server errorlog over the last 24 hours.

name: Index Fragmentation
description: Per-index logical fragmentation across all user databases with a reorganize/rebuild recommendation.

name: Instance Identity & Properties
description: SERVERPROPERTY inventory: identity, edition, version/patch level, HA state, security mode, default paths and install date.

name: Agent Job Run History
description: Complete SQL Agent run history for the last 48 hours: every step of every run with status, duration and the command executed.

name: Agent Job Inventory
description: Definition-level inventory of SQL Agent jobs: owner, category, enabled state, failure notification wiring and schedules.

name: Backup Recency & Chain
description: Latest backup per database per type (Full/Differential/Log) with device, LSN chain, size and duration - and databases with NO backup at all.

name: Server Permission Inventory
description: Server-level permissions AND server role memberships per principal - the complete instance-level privilege picture.

name: Long-Running Executions vs Baseline
description: Currently executing statements that run long against their own historical average - the live regression detector.

name: Missing Index Suggestions
description: Deduplicated missing-index suggestions across the instance, ranked by estimated advantage, with ready CREATE INDEX statements.

name: Orphaned Database Users
description: Database users whose SID no longer matches any server login, across every database - dead identities that block logins or linger as risk.

name: OS Memory State
description: Operating-system memory state paired with the SQL Server process footprint: the complete external memory-pressure picture.

name: SQL Login Password Hygiene
description: Password policy, age and weakness audit for every SQL login: policy/expiration enforcement, password age, lockout state, blank and name-equal passwords.

name: Scheduler Health
description: Per-scheduler task, worker and queue state: CPU pressure (runnable tasks), pending disk I/O stuck at schedulers, and offline-scheduler detection.

name: In-Flight I/O Requests
description: Point-in-time list of I/O requests currently outstanding, resolved to the database file, with how long each has been pending and WHERE it is stuck.

name: SQL Memory Breakdown
description: Memory Manager counter breakdown: where SQL Server memory actually goes - cache, stolen, locks, optimizer, workspace grants - plus grant queue state.

name: Processor Hardware Identity
description: The physical CPU model string (and clock speed) paired with the logical/physical CPU topology - the hardware baseline for capacity and licensing.

name: Database Properties & Log State
description: Per-database recovery model, log reuse wait, transaction log size/usage, and the safety/perf option flags in one row.

name: SQL Server Services Status
description: State, startup type and service account of the SQL Server services (Engine, Agent, Full-Text) via the cross-platform dm_server_services.

name: Wait Statistics
description: Top cumulative waits since startup with the noise filtered out: resource vs signal (CPU) split, percent of total and average wait - the first stop in any performance triage.

name: SQL Login Inventory
description: Full inventory of SQL-authenticated logins: identity, SID, default database/language, mapped credential, policy flags and password hash algorithm.

name: Table Sizes
description: The largest tables across every database with their row count and reserved/data/index/unused space breakdown.

name: TempDB File Configuration
description: TempDB data and log file layout with the classic tempdb-health checks: file count vs CPUs, equal-size verification and percent-growth anti-pattern.

name: TempDB Space Consumers
description: Live requests currently consuming tempdb, ranked by outstanding user + internal object space, with the statement and session behind each.

name: Transaction Throughput by Database
description: Cumulative transaction, write-transaction and log-flush counters per database - the workload-distribution and write-intensity view.

name: Unused Nonclustered Indexes
description: Nonclustered indexes with zero reads (seeks/scans/lookups) since startup but ongoing write maintenance - pure write overhead across all databases.

name: Database Permission Grants
description: Explicit database-level permission grants per user (object, schema and database scope) across every database - the database-tier privilege inventory.

name: Windows & External Login Inventory
description: Inventory of every non-SQL login (Windows login/group, Azure AD, certificate/key-mapped) with disabled state, default database and fixed-server-role membership.
